title.value: Studying the Practices of Deploying Machine Learning Projects on Docker
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the first page of the paper, which gives a clear indication of the main focus of the study.
title.quote: Studying the Practices of Deploying Machine Learning Projects on Docker

extractions.description: The paper explores how Docker is used to deploy machine learning (ML)-based projects. It categorizes ML projects that use Docker, analyzes why and how Docker is used in these projects, and identifies the characteristics of Docker images. The study aims to provide insights into the deployment practices of ML software projects using Docker and highlight areas for improvement.

primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily focused on the technical study of deploying machine learning projects using Docker rather than on eco-responsible practices. It does not directly relate to any eco-responsible categories such as climate change, pollution, or sustainable finance.
primary_category.quote: In this study, we conducted an exploratory empirical study to understand how Docker is being used in the deployment process of ML-based software projects.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not fit into any specific eco-responsible sub-category as defined in the list. Its focus is on software engineering practices rather than environmental impact or sustainability.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our results indicate that six categories of ML-based projects use Docker for deployment, including ML Applications, MLOps/ AIOps, Toolkits, DL Frameworks, Models, and Documentation.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not introduce a new eco-responsible category; its focus is on practical insights into deploying ML projects rather than addressing environmental or sustainability issues.
new_primary_category.quote: We hope to shed light on the emerging practices of deploying ML software projects using containers and highlight aspects that should be improved.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new eco-responsible sub-category is suggested as the paper revolves around deployment practices, not environmental impact.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The objective of this question is to understand the kinds of automation provided by Docker that are used in the deployment of ML-based software projects.
